errors.text_span: Die horizontale Kategorieachse listet von links nach rechts die drei Rohstoffkategorien „Aluminium“, „Kupfer“ und „Nickel“ in alphabetischer Reihenfolge auf.
errors.evidence: The categories are not in alphabetical order (Aluminium, Kupfer, Nickel is not alphabetical, which would place Kupfer before Nickel and Aluminium depending on language sorting). The figure shows the categories in the order Aluminium, Kupfer, Nickel, but not explicitly as alphabetical.
